definition: OMIM #620785 refers to Neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive movement abnormalities (NEDPM), a genetic disorder caused by biallelic loss-of-function variants in the ACBD6 gene that manifests with neurodevelopmental delay accompanied by progressive hypo- and hyperkinetic movement manifestations.
